items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I had a conversation with Ignacio Berroa and he talked about trying to pick up American radio... And I’m wondering about your experience.

ctx.x: Yeah it’s inside. If you grew up in that culture with that music, the clave is inside of you. It’s there. And we know, it doesn’t necessarily have to be a percussionist, you know the pianist – every one of us playing knows where it is. If they know this music you know, they really understand the music, the culture. It’s just a thing. It may be, you know, if we didn’t have a drummer right know and a bass player and a guitar player start playing some real funky stuff, you immediately go to [claps] two and four.…
Were you able to hear American music when you were around 15 or so? I had a conversation with Ignacio Berroa and he talked about trying to pick up American radio © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
stations and the gymnastics they had to go through with the antennas and all this. And I’m wondering about your experience.
